Class TransactionReceiptService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.receipt.TransactionReceiptService
@Service public class TransactionReceiptService extends Object
Creates transaction receipt PDFs for selected security transactions and writes them to the HTTP response. A single selected transaction is returned as a plain PDF; multiple transactions are bundled into a ZIP archive with one PDF per transaction.

File names follow the pattern yyyyMMdd_<localized type word>.pdf. When more than one selected transaction falls on the same calendar day, those file names are extended with the transaction time to yyyyMMdd_HHmmss_<type word>.pdf; a residual collision (same second and type) gets a numeric suffix. The receipt language and the type word follow the language of the authenticated user (German or English).

  • Method Details

    • createReceipts

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public void createReceipts(List<Integer> idTransactions, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse response) throws Exception
      Generates the receipts for the given transaction IDs of the authenticated tenant and writes a single PDF or a ZIP archive to the response.
      Parameters:
      idTransactions - the selected transaction IDs; every ID must belong to a supported security transaction of the user's tenant
      response - the HTTP response the document is streamed to
      Throws:
      Exception - if a transaction is missing/unsupported or PDF generation fails
